OUR STORY

ABOUT US

The House of Fragal

FRAGAL is a Pakistani fragrance house built on a simple belief — a scent should stay. On your clothes, in the room, and in memory, long after you have left. Our tagline is our promise: Scents That Stay.
settings.body_html:
Our Beginning

Fragal began with a single creation: ZARAN. Instead of launching with a shelf full of fragrances, we poured everything into one — a fresh & floral signature for men, crafted with 40% perfume concentration to linger for 8+ hours on clothes. We believe one fragrance, done properly, says more than ten done in haste.

What We Stand For

01

Scents That Stay

Longevity is our signature. ZARAN is made to stay noticeable for 8+ hours, sprayed on clothes — living up to the name on the bottle.

02

No Inflated Claims

We say what we mean. No invented fragrance notes, no fake reviews, no borrowed luxury. What you read on this website is what we stand behind.

03

Made in Pakistan

A Pakistani house with honest Pakistani pricing — premium craft without the imported price tag.

04

Direct & Personal

Message us on WhatsApp before and after your order. Quick answers from real people, no ticket queues.

Meet the Founder

Fragal was founded by Hashim, on the belief that Pakistan deserves its own luxury fragrance house — one that competes on craft, not on markup. From the scent to the box to the bag, every detail carries his eye.

Our Promise

One fragrance at a time. Honest craft. Fair prices. Scents that stay.
